quests.instruction: Tomorrow's timetable is Math, Art, and PE. Which group of items should you pack?
quests.correctAnswer: Math notebook, art apron, sports shoes 🎒
options: Math notebook, art apron, sports shoes 🎒
Art apron, library book, calculator 🧮
Math notebook, dictionary, crayons 🖍️
quests.hint: Match each lesson to something it needs.
quests.explanation: Reading your timetable and matching each lesson to what it needs keeps you from forgetting things.
quests.funFact: Some students pin a copy of the timetable inside their bag.

quests.instruction: Which tool helps you remember everything you need to pack?
quests.correctAnswer: A checklist ✅
options: A dictionary 📖
A checklist ✅
A globe 🌍
quests.hint: It lists things so you can tick them off.
quests.explanation: A checklist lets you see at a glance what is packed and what is missing.
quests.funFact: Pilots use checklists before every flight.

quests.instruction: It's Wednesday and your timetable says 'Library' on Thursday. What should you remember to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Pack the library book you need to return 📚
options: Pack your art apron for a painting lesson 🥼
Pack the library book you need to return 📚
Pack your sports shoes for PE tomorrow 👟
quests.hint: Think about what you do in the library.
quests.explanation: Checking the next day's timetable reminds you of things like returning a library book.
quests.funFact: Many libraries charge nothing, but expect books back on time.

quests.instruction: How can you quickly tell your notebooks apart in your bag?
quests.correctAnswer: Write the subject name on each cover 🏷️
options: Write the subject name on each cover 🏷️
Keep them all together without any names 📓
Stack them in a different order each day 📚
quests.hint: Think about finding the right one fast.
quests.explanation: A subject label on the cover tells you which notebook is which at a glance.
quests.funFact: Different cover colors for different subjects also help.

quests.instruction: You start a new topic in your science notebook. What is a tidy way to begin?
quests.correctAnswer: Start a new page with a heading 📝
options: Write over the old notes 🖊️
Squeeze it in at the bottom of the last page ✏️
Start a new page with a heading 📝
quests.explanation: A fresh page and a heading make it easy to find the topic later.
quests.funFact: Headings can be underlined to make them stand out.

quests.instruction: Why is it useful to have one notebook for each subject?
quests.correctAnswer: Notes stay together and are easier to find 🔍
options: So each notebook can be filled much faster 📓
So your bag feels heavier each day 🎒
Notes stay together and are easier to find 🔍
quests.explanation: Keeping each subject's notes together saves time when you revise.
quests.funFact: Some students use one notebook with colored sections for each subject.

quests.instruction: You have worksheets for math and for science. How can you keep them neat?
quests.correctAnswer: Use a separate folder for each subject 📁
options: Fold them small and put them in your pocket 👖
Mix them together in one pile 📚
Use a separate folder for each subject 📁
quests.explanation: Separate folders keep each subject's papers together, so you don't dig for them.
quests.funFact: Colored folders make subjects easy to spot.

quests.instruction: Your teacher hands back a marked test. Where should you put it?
quests.correctAnswer: In a folder for corrected work ✅
options: In the recycling bin because it's finished ♻️
In a folder for corrected work ✅
At the bottom of your bag with your lunch 🎒
quests.hint: Marked work shows what to practice.
quests.explanation: Keeping corrected work lets you look at your mistakes before the next test.
quests.funFact: Looking back at old tests can show how much you have improved.

quests.instruction: You want your worksheet to fit neatly in your ring binder. What tool makes holes in the paper?
quests.correctAnswer: Hole punch 🕳️
options: Hole punch 🕳️
Stapler 🗜️
Sharpener ✏️
quests.hint: The holes must match the rings.
quests.explanation: A hole punch makes evenly spaced holes, so paper clips onto the rings.
quests.funFact: Most hole punches make holes that are 8 cm apart.

quests.instruction: Mon: Math, Art. Tue: PE, Music. Wed: Science, Library. On which day do you need your sports kit?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuesday 📅
options: Tuesday 📅
Monday 📅
Wednesday 📅
quests.explanation: Matching a lesson to its day on the timetable tells you when to bring the right things.
quests.funFact: School timetables often repeat every week.

quests.instruction: Your day is: 9:00 Reading, 10:00 Math, 11:00 Break, 11:15 Art. What comes right after Math?
quests.correctAnswer: Break 🧃
options: Break 🧃
Reading 📖
Art 🎨
quests.hint: Look at the times in order.
quests.explanation: Reading the times in order shows what comes next.
quests.funFact: Times on a timetable run from the start of the day to the end.

quests.instruction: A lesson is 40 minutes long and starts at 10:00. When does it end?
quests.hint: Add the minutes to the start time.
quests.explanation: Adding 40 minutes to 10:00 gives 10:40.
quests.funFact: There are 60 minutes in an hour, so 40 minutes is two-thirds of an hour.

quests.instruction: You have a task due next week. What helps you remember it?
quests.correctAnswer: Writing it on a calendar or in your diary 📔
options: Telling a friend and asking nothing more 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
Trusting yourself to remember it all 🤞
Writing it on a calendar or in your diary 📔
quests.explanation: A written reminder keeps due dates from slipping your mind.
quests.funFact: Writing things down frees your brain for thinking.

quests.instruction: You have three tasks: a math worksheet due tomorrow, a poster due next week, and a book to read for fun. Which do you do first?
quests.correctAnswer: The math worksheet 📝
options: The math worksheet 📝
The fun book 📖
The poster 🖼️
quests.explanation: Doing the task that's due soonest first stops you from running out of time.
quests.funFact: Sorting tasks by deadline is a simple way to plan.

quests.instruction: A to-do list is most useful when you...
quests.correctAnswer: Cross off each task as you finish it ✅
options: Write it and never look at it again 🙈
Cross off each task as you finish it ✅
Make it very long just in case 📜
quests.explanation: Checking off tasks helps you see progress and what's left.
quests.funFact: Many people use a paper planner or a calendar app to keep track of tasks.

quests.instruction: Your desk is covered with crumbs, papers, and a toy. What's the first step before starting homework?
quests.correctAnswer: Clear away what you don't need 🧹
options: Start working over the mess ✏️
Clear away what you don't need 🧹
Add more things to the desk 📚
quests.explanation: Clearing your space lets you focus on the work in front of you.
quests.funFact: A clear desk helps your brain avoid distractions.

quests.instruction: Which setup helps you concentrate best while studying?
quests.correctAnswer: Only the things you need within reach 📚
options: A TV on in the room for company 📺
Only the things you need within reach 📚
A pile of toys close by for breaks 🧸
quests.explanation: When only the things you need are in front of you, you can keep your attention on the task.
quests.funFact: Switching between tasks can take extra time and attention.

quests.instruction: You write with your right hand. Where should the desk lamp shine from?
quests.correctAnswer: From your left side 💡
options: From behind your head 💡
From your right side 💡
From your left side 💡
quests.hint: Think about where your hand's shadow falls.
quests.explanation: A lamp on the opposite side from your writing hand keeps your hand from casting a shadow on the page.
quests.funFact: For left-handed writers, the lamp goes on the right side.

quests.instruction: You solved 9 + 6 = 15. How can you check it a different way?
quests.correctAnswer: Take 6 from 15 and see if you get 9 🔁
options: Count slowly from 1 up to 20 🔢
Take 6 from 15 and see if you get 9 🔁
Add 9 and 6 again in the same way ➕
quests.explanation: Subtracting backwards shows whether your addition was correct.
quests.funFact: Addition and subtraction are 'opposites' that can check each other.

quests.instruction: Before you hand in a piece of writing, which is a helpful thing to check?
quests.correctAnswer: Your name, capitals, and full stops ✔️
options: The color of your pen and its brand 🖊️
Your name, capitals, and full stops ✔️
The size of your paper and its color 📄
quests.explanation: A quick check of names and punctuation catches small mistakes.
quests.funFact: Reading your writing aloud helps you spot missing words.

quests.instruction: You wrote 8 + 5 = 12. Which check shows a mistake?
options: Look at the answer and nod 👀
Count back from 12 to 8 and say 'good' ✅
quests.hint: Count carefully one at a time.
quests.explanation: Counting on step by step shows the answer is 13, so you can correct it.
quests.funFact: Counting on is a quick way to check small sums.

quests.instruction: What is best written in a school diary?
quests.correctAnswer: Homework and due dates 📝
options: Your lunch menu 🍽️
Homework and due dates 📝
Your favorite song lyrics 🎶
quests.hint: Think about what you need to remember.
quests.explanation: A diary keeps track of what you need to do and when.
quests.funFact: A planner or diary page often has a space for each school day of the week.

quests.instruction: Why should you write the due date next to the homework?
quests.correctAnswer: So you know when it must be finished 🗓️
options: So you know when it must be finished 🗓️
So the page looks full 📄
So the teacher can read your handwriting ✍️
quests.hint: It tells you when time is up.
quests.explanation: The due date lets you plan your time, so you don't leave work until the last moment.
quests.funFact: A task with no date is easy to forget.

quests.instruction: Your diary says 'Bring the signed form on Friday.' What do you do on Thursday evening?
quests.correctAnswer: Put the signed form in your bag 📄
options: Put the signed form in your bag 📄
Leave it at home until after the weekend 🏠
Give it to a friend to keep 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
quests.explanation: Packing it the evening before means you won't forget it in the morning rush.
quests.funFact: A form left at home can't be handed in at school.

quests.instruction: It is raining on your walk to school. How can you keep your library book safe?
quests.correctAnswer: Put it in a bag or plastic cover 🎒
options: Put it in a bag or plastic cover 🎒
Hold it over your head as an umbrella ☔
Leave it on a ledge to dry out 🌧️
quests.explanation: Wet pages wrinkle and can't easily be fixed, so protect books from rain.
quests.funFact: Libraries ask readers to look after books so many others can enjoy them.

quests.instruction: What is the best way to turn the pages of a book?
quests.correctAnswer: Gently, from the corner 📖
options: Quickly, with a flick 💨
By licking your finger 👅
Gently, from the corner 📖
quests.explanation: Turning pages gently stops them from tearing or getting creased.
quests.funFact: Pages can tear more easily when pulled from the middle.

quests.instruction: You need a break from reading. How should you keep your place?
quests.correctAnswer: Use a bookmark and close the book 🔖
options: Leave the book open and face down 📕
Fold the corner of the page 📄
Use a bookmark and close the book 🔖
quests.hint: Don't bend or strain the spine.
quests.explanation: A bookmark keeps your place without damaging the pages or the spine.
quests.funFact: Leaving a book face down can break its spine.

quests.instruction: What are notes?
quests.correctAnswer: Short points to recall key ideas 📝
options: A copy of every word the teacher says ✍️
Pictures with no words 🖼️
Short points to recall key ideas 📝
quests.explanation: Notes are short reminders of important ideas, so you can study later.
quests.funFact: Notes work best in your own words.

quests.instruction: Your teacher is explaining the life cycle of a frog. What is the best way to take notes?
quests.correctAnswer: Write key words and short phrases ✍️
options: Draw only doodles around the page 🎨
Write key words and short phrases ✍️
Copy every word you hear 📜
quests.explanation: Writing key words and short phrases is quicker and helps you remember the big ideas.
quests.funFact: Arrows can show steps in a life cycle.

quests.instruction: How can you keep notes from different subjects organized?
quests.correctAnswer: Keep each subject in its own notebook or section 🔖
options: Keep each subject in its own notebook or section 🔖
Pile the loose pages in the bottom of your bag 📚
Mix all of them together on the same pages 📄
quests.explanation: Separate sections let you find what you need quickly when it's time to revise.
quests.funFact: Page numbers and a contents list make notebooks even easier to use.
